The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Suljo Warde]] created a '''holocron''' into which he put all of his knowledge of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Warde divided up the [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|Kyber crystals]] within the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], which meant that it would be difficult for anyone to reassemble the entire device.<ref name="CotG" />
